intended_object: A dummy variable picked to be fresh for one particular syntactic class expression. It is used for alpha-renaming inside a machine-generated nominal proof certificate (the docstring says "checked nominal proof certificate ... nb058_alpha_dummy_041").
explanation: The body applies `freshVar` to the union of a term's free variables with itself and takes index 0. The term is `synCnin (synCpw (synCuni (cv nb058AlphaDummy000))) synC1c`. The result is just a chosen variable name that does not clash with existing ones, so that bound variables can be renamed during the formal proof replay. It is an internal device of an automatically generated proof, with no mathematical counterpart. Mathlib has nothing comparable. I judged this from the definition text alone and did not search the library.
